selection_order: ascending SHA-256 UTF-8(seed + doc_id), first 20 per language
population: decision=detected; language=cze/srp/rus and damage_rate>0.25, or language=hrv at any nonempty damage_rate
audit_score_reconciliation: 80/80 language, decision, rounded damage_rate and near-count matches
annotation: Copilot lexical screening, not human ground truth. Type-level likely-error decisions plus occurrence-specific valid-word decisions. Unresolved is not an OCR error.
retrieval: AzureCliCredential, read-only blob properties and range downloads; doc_id column and text row groups only; resumable local cache; no production writes; no public search API calls.
